purpose: taxids for 25 clade/species names, by exact ontology label, batch 1
sparql: PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX obo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/> SELECT ?t ?l WHERE { ?t rdfs:label ?l . FILTER(REGEX(STR(?t),'NCBITaxon_[0-9]+$')) FILTER(REGEX(?l, "^(Metazoa|Eumetazoa|Bilateria|Deuterostomia|Protostomia|Chordata|Craniata|Vertebrata|Gnathostomata|Euteleostomi|Chondrichthyes|Cyclostomata|Actinopterygii|Actinopteri|Neopterygii|Teleostei|Clupeocephala|Otomorpha|Otophysi|Cypriniformes|Danionidae|Danio|Acanthomorphata|Acanthopterygii|Percomorphaceae)( <[^>]*>)?$")) }
